Panorama · window sizes · thresholds in effective pixels (DIP)

Four width tiers, one height rule

The thresholds and what collapses at each are Zune's structure: the right panel goes inline at 1008, the play bar steps narrow → medium at 760 and full at 1240, and Huge docks two panes from 1920. Panorama's one exception is typographic: panorama titles drop from Display 68 to Title Large below 1000 px; that is a type rule, not a tier edge. Panorama renders each tier with WinUI parts. The pivot band stays 88 tall in every tier; only what sits inside it changes.

Scale is logarithmic; thresholds are Zune’s. The real minimum window is 300 DIP wide, so Compact covers 300–639. Below 360 Recents moves from row 1 into the More flyout.

Height

Title bar 48, band 88 and play bar 84 are reserved first: 220 of every height. At 600 tall the page gets 380. Below 720 tall entity heroes become one header row (art 112, Title Large, actions beside the title) and full-screen art caps at 40 % of the height. Below 520 tall the band keeps its 88; the play bar switches to the 64 mini bar, so the page gets everything above 200. Below 400 tall (down to the 340 minimum, 140 left for the page) the header row shrinks again: art 64, the title at Subtitle 20/28 with the actions on its line, so at least one row of content stays in view. Panorama titles keep their own rule: Title Large below 1000 wide.
